Beam

Move a file between two devices through the screen and the camera. No Wi-Fi, cable or account. Open this page on both.

Reduce size

CompressionBoth keep every word, number and picture

With a password, the file is encrypted (AES-256) before it leaves this device. The receiver must type it to open the file; without it nothing can be read, not even the name.

No camera found on this device, so it can send but not receive.

Speed testFind the fastest settings for these two devices. Start it here on the sender; on the other device just tap Receive and it measures by itself.
Export and importExport the codes as a PDF to print, images or a slideshow, for any screen or paper. Anyone can scan them with Receive, or load the files or photos of the pages with Import.

To receive, tap Receive and point the camera at the other screen. The camera works when Beam is opened from its https:// link, or on a computer through start-beam (localhost).
